reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a network-based earning scheme by presenting a claimed €200 bonus from direct sales and team activity as an attractive result. The speaker explicitly invites viewers to join his “POWER LEG,” while the dashboard shows direct-sponsored members, a downline, and a network bonus, making participation and recruitment central to the promised commissions.

citations.quote: Join my World Wide POWER LEG
direct sales they gave me 100 euros last week and Network bonus which means what the team have done together has also got me to another hundred
as soon as 60% goes in my cash account I'm gonna go to accounts and withdraw live in front of you

opening.argument: The video presents a provisional, self-checking account of one week rather than a guaranteed income claim. The speaker says the withdrawal is not yet available, acknowledges that he does not know when the account transfer will occur, and explicitly says he cannot confirm the process until he has experienced it himself. He promises to show the withdrawal and bank-credit process only if and when those conditions occur. That repeated uncertainty is a material qualification: viewers are shown an unresolved test, not assured financial results.

citations.quote: it hasn't actually transferred here I can't do the withdrawal yet
when that will be I don't know it's my first week
until I've gone through that process I can't do that
as soon as it hits my UK account I will log in to my UK account and we will see the money in there

rebuttal.rebuttal: The invitation to join a “POWER LEG” does not establish that the speaker guaranteed anyone an outcome. The cited €200 is described as an account result, while the proposed withdrawal is expressly future and conditional. The dashboard alone cannot show whether participation is deceptive or what joining entails.

citations.quote: Join my World Wide POWER LEG
so that that's where is anything for matching bonus nothing yet
as soon as 60% goes in my cash account I'm gonna go to accounts and withdraw live in front of you

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Acknowledging that a withdrawal has not yet occurred does not neutralize the promotional message. The speaker still foregrounds a claimed €200 earned from direct and team activity and invites viewers to follow the process toward withdrawal. The uncertainty shows the result is unverified, not that the underlying earning opportunity is ordinary or safe.

citations.quote: what the team have done together has also got me to another hundred
lifetime earnings 200
Join my World Wide POWER LEG

opening.argument: The stated purpose is an operational walkthrough of an account and its bonus workflow. The speaker explains why the recording was delayed, opens the bonus area, distinguishes the displayed sources of the amount, and plans a later installment showing how the balance is divided. He describes himself as investigating the process firsthand and tells viewers that he is showing the journey so he can report accurately after completing it. This is a personal demonstration of account mechanics, with verification still pending, rather than proof that viewers will profit.

citations.quote: so let's go to my account
so i've put in a support ticket and i've asked them
I'm here to find out everything for you
that's why I'm the lab rat as such

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of bonus labels and a network page describes what the demonstration examines; it does not by itself prove the video is primarily a solicitation. The speaker does not claim the pending bank payment has occurred. His announced follow-up is specifically to document the split and processing time, which is consistent with an operational review.

citations.quote: Because part two, I need to show how this is split into a 60% cash account and a 40% into a mandatory account
until I've gone through that process I can't do that

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it a walkthrough does not change what the walkthrough emphasizes: direct sales, team activity, bonuses, and a route to withdrawal. The speaker's proposed future verification leaves the claimed earning unconfirmed, while the invitation and displayed network structure give the demonstration promotional force.

citations.quote: direct sales they gave me 100 euros last week and Network bonus which means what the team have done together has also got me to another hundred
as soon as 60% goes in my cash account I'm gonna go to accounts and withdraw live in front of you

opening.argument: The supplied material does not establish several features that would be needed to characterize this as a completed scam transaction: no deposit amount is stated, no guaranteed return is promised, no credential request is shown, and no completed bank payment is reported. Instead, the speaker discusses an account display, a support ticket, and a possible future withdrawal. Even the account language describes a division between a cash account and a mandatory trading account, not a demonstrated loss or fraudulent outcome. On this record, the evidence supports a business-platform demonstration whose safety and eventual payment remain unresolved.

citations.quote: so i've put in a support ticket and i've asked them
it hasn't actually transferred here I can't do the withdrawal yet
as soon as it hits my UK account I will log in to my UK account and we will see the money in there

rebuttal.rebuttal: A team bonus and member dashboard do not prove a fraudulent mechanism without evidence of payment demands, guaranteed returns, or a completed loss. The title's use of “Bonuses” and the displayed account are compatible with reporting on a commercial platform. The cited invitation establishes promotion, but not deception or the terms of joining.

citations.quote: Network bonus which means what the team have done together has also got me to another hundred
Bonus & Commissions Paid

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not limited to a completed loss or a credential request. The video promotes participation in a multi-person earning structure by presenting direct-sales and team-generated bonuses as the central benefit. The dashboard's network information and the invitation to join supply the mechanism's promotional context even though the promised withdrawal remains pending.
